tha-ap48:1.1: Padumacchadaniya.] Nibbute lokanāthamhi Vipassimh' aggapuggale / suphullaṃ padumaṃ gayha citam āropayiṃ ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap48:2.1: Āropite ca citake vehasan nabham uggamiṃ / ākāsacchadanaṃ katvā citakamhi adhārayiṃ. // //
tha-ap48:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāni Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap48:4.1: Sattatālīs' ito kappe Padumissaranāmako / cāturanto vijitāvī cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap48:5.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh ime / chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap48:6.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Padumacchadaniyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
